mapper.sql: id, tenant_id AS tenantId, identity_id AS identityId, kind, secret_hash AS secretHash, last4, status, expires_at AS expiresAt, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, revoked_at AS revokedAt, revoked_by AS revokedBy
mapper.select: SELECT FROM oa_iam.credential WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND identity_id = CAST(#{identityId} AS uuid) ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_iam.credential SET status = #{status}, revoked_by = #{revokedBy}, revoked_at = #{revokedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE oa_iam.credential SET status = 'REVOKED', revoked_by = #{revokedBy}, revoked_at = #{revokedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND identity_id = CAST(#{identityId} AS uuid) AND status = 'ACTIVE'
